posts.author: ashish_agnihotri
posts.text: Aumelortinib which is to be launched in H2 of this FY is in direct competition with tagrisso of AstraZeneca,. Tagrisso has a median progression free survival of 18 month against 28 of aumelortinib. Also aumelortinib has lower side effects. Tagrisso sales approx 600 cr pa and growing.
